Updating spec, options, renderer, or actions redraws the visualization and finalizes the previous Vega view. Successful and failed renders dispatch vega-ready and vega-error events. This first pass accepts declarative specifications. It does not wrap every method in Vega’s View API.

Open the chart example (source). The browser example runs Python through Pyodide, so it needs no install or server. Each timer event travels from the browser to a Python model through Spaday and transports. Python updates all three specifications, and Spaday patches the existing chart elements with the returned values. The example includes native Vega and Vega-Lite specifications.
